rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı first takes “sirr” as what one tells oneself and “ahfā” as what is still yet to occur.
rows.anchor: “Sır” içinden kendine söylediğin, “ahfâ” olacak fakat henüz olmamış bulunandır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, “sirr” is what one whispers secretly to another, while “ahfā” is what one conceals within oneself.
rows.anchor: Yahut “sır” başkasına gizli söylediğin, “ahfâ” nefsinde gizlediğindir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also reports a past-tense reading of “ahfā”: God knows creatures’ secrets but has hidden His own.
rows.anchor: Bir de “ahfâ” fi‘l-i mâzî olmak üzere mâna verilmiştir, yani kulların sırrını bilir, kendi sırrını ise gizlemiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites a hadith counting the beautiful names as ninety-nine and promising Paradise to whoever enumerates them.
rows.anchor: Bir hadîs-i şerifte doksan [3319] dokuz sayılmış ve “bunu sayan cennete girer” buyurulmuştur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı renders the appointment as on Ṭūr’s right side and identifies manna and quail as kudret helvası and bıldırcın.
rows.anchor: ve size Tûr’un sağ tarafına vaad verdik ve üzerinize kudret helvası ve bıldırcın indirdik

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the consequence of divine wrath as falling into an abyss.
rows.anchor: her kim üzerine de gazabım inerse o uçuruma gider

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders “then he is guided” as continuing on the right way after repentance, faith, and good works.
rows.anchor: sonra da doğru giden kimse için gaffârım

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says the people are following his tracks and that he hurried ahead to please his Lord.
rows.anchor: “Onlar” dedi, “benim izim üzerindeler ve ben Sana acele ettim ki Rabbim hoşnut olasın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders God’s testing of the people as leading them into trial, with al-Sāmirī making them go astray.
rows.anchor: Biz senin ardından kavmini fitneye düşürdük, Sâmirî onları şaşırttı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He characterizes Moses’ return as both wrathful and sorrowful, matching the two qualities in the verse.
rows.anchor: Derhâl Mûsâ kavmine gazabnâk, esefnâk olarak döndü.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the calf as a carcass that had a bellowing sound.
rows.anchor: Derken onlara bir dana, böğürmesi var bir ceset çıkardı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the two negated landscape features as crookedness and a raised lump or mound.
rows.anchor: Onda ne bir eğrilik ne bir yumruluk göremeyeceksin

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the only sound heard on that day as a faint rustling or whispering sound, “hışıltı.”
rows.anchor: artık bir hışıltıdan başka bir şey işitmezsin

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the permitted intercession as restricted to one whom the Merciful allows and whose speech He approves.
rows.anchor: ancak Rahmân’ın izin verdiği ve sözüne râzı olduğu kimse müstesnâ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders God as the true, exalted sovereign and preserves the prayer asking God to increase the Prophet’s knowledge.
rows.anchor: sana vahyi tamam edilmeden evvel Kur’ân’ı acele etme ve de ki رَبِّ زِدْن۪ي عِلْماً “Rabbim artır beni ilimce”

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He says God had made a covenant with Adam, who forgot it, and that Adam lacked resolve.
rows.anchor: Fi’l-hakīka bundan evvel Âdem’e ahid verdik de unuttu ve Biz onda bir azim bulmadık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading is that Muhammad was sent only from mercy toward all realms, especially rational beings.
rows.anchor: başka bir sebep için değil ancak bütün âlemlere ve bâhusus zevi’l-ukūl âlemlerine merhamet ettiğimiz için

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, he was sent only in the state of being mercy, and is himself a universal mercy from God.
rows.anchor: veya başka bir hâlde değil ancak âlemîne bir rahmet olarak resul gönderdik; risaletin umûma bir rahmet-i ilâhiye veya sen bir rahmet-i âmmesin

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet guides rational beings to righteousness and salvation, teaches the religion that brings felicity in both abodes, and benefits all creation.
rows.anchor: bütün zevi’l-ukūl âlemlerine o salâh ve halâs yolunu göstereceksin, dâreynde sebeb-i saadet olan dini sen tâlim edeceksin

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı warns that the wretched flee this mercy and shut their eyes to its light.
rows.anchor: Artık vay o bedbahtlara ki bu rahmetten kaçınırlar ve bu nûra karşı göz yumarlar.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He presents the declaration of one God as the basis of every command and all well-being, with every other deity being false.
rows.anchor: Hepinizin ilâhı ancak bir ilâhtır ki Allah’tır. Bâlâda isbat olunduğu üzere mâ‘adâsı bâtıldır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Accepting the revelation entails yielding to the one God with complete sincerity.
rows.anchor: Bu vahyi teslim edip kemâl-i ihlâs ile hepiniz bir ilâha inkıyâdı kabul ediyor musunuz?

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because îzān can mean a declaration of war, Elmalılı reads this as telling Meccan polytheists their state of relations had become war.
rows.anchor: “Îzân” hâl-i harb ilan etmek mânasına da geldiğine göre, bu âyetin nüzûlüyle Resûlullah Mekke müşriklerine karşı vaziyetin hâl-i harb olduğunu anlatmış demek olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He treats the verse as announcing the coming Battle of Badr from this moment onward.
rows.anchor: Bedir Muharebesi’nin ilânı da bu andan itibaren yapılmış demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promised event is inevitable but may mean the triumph of true religion, Muslim victory, or the Resurrection; its timing is unknown.
rows.anchor: dîn-i hakkın zuhûru, Müslimînin galebesi veyahut kıyametin kopması lâbüd olduğunda şüphe yoksa da yakın mı uzak mı bilmem.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening verse’s claim that the reckoning has drawn near reflects the principle that every future event is near.
rows.anchor: Sûrenin başında ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ buyurulması “her âtî karîb” olmak itibariyledir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God knows public and concealed speech, He also knows when their punishment is due.
rows.anchor: binâen‘aleyh cezânızın vaktini de bilir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A delayed threat is a trial and istidrāj that enlarges their punishment, while also giving temporary enjoyment until the appointed time.
rows.anchor: sizin için bir fitnedir cezâ ve mihnetinizi büyütmek için bir istidrac

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses’ prayer asks God to judge with truth, meaning that He should not withhold justice.
rows.anchor: Rabbim! Hak ile hükmünü ver adaletin gecirgemesin

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Merciful is the aid sought against accusations of magic, confused dreams, fabrication, poetry, and blasphemy against Islam and Muslims.
rows.anchor: Sihirdir, edgāsü ahlâmdır, iftiradır, şiirdir gibi isnadlarınıza, dîn-i İslâm ve Müslimîn aleyhindeki küfriyâtınıza karşı avn u nusreti matlub olan ancak O’dur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Venerating God’s sacred signs is an expression and protection of the heart’s piety.
rows.anchor: muhakkak o ta‘zîmât kalblerin takvâsındandır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pilgrimage offerings and great sacrificial animals, as sacred signs, should be revered and sacrificed only in God’s name.
rows.anchor: şe‘âirden olan hac hediylerine, o büyük kurbanlara tâzim etmeli, hürmetle bakmalı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The offerings provide worldly benefits for a period, including milk, offspring, wool, and service.
rows.anchor: Sağımından, dölünden, tüyünden, hizmetinden vesâiresinden bir vakte kadar birçok istifadeler edilir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their final destination is sacrifice at Mina, which is their benefit in the hereafter.
rows.anchor: Mina’da kurban olurlar ki bu da menfa‘at-i uhreviyeleridir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated mention of the Ancient House emphasizes the Kaaba’s liberation from polytheists and cleansing of idols.
rows.anchor: Burada Beyt-i Atîk fâsılasının tercî‘i Kâbe’nin müşriklerden tahlîsiyle putlardan tathîri kaziyyesini tekiddir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every community received a place of worship and sacrifice so its members could invoke God’s name over the livestock He provided.
rows.anchor: Her ümmet için bir mensek, yani bir ibadet ve kurban yeri yaptık ki

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God is one and appointed a ritual place for each community, worship and sacrifice must be sincerely directed to Him without shirk.
rows.anchor: ancak O’na -O vâhid olan ilâha- islâm ediniz ihlâs ile ibadet ediniz de zikrinizi, kurbanınızı şirk ile şâibedâr etmeyiniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humble are those whose hearts tremble when God is mentioned and who feel His majesty immediately within them.
rows.anchor: ki Allah denilince kalbleri çarpar Celâl-i Kibriyâ’nın derhâl yüreklerinde parladığını hissederler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humble also endure hardship, maintain prayer, and spend their provision through zakat, charity, sacrifice, and feeding others.
rows.anchor: Kendilerine isabet eden zahmetlere karşı da sabırlıdırlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı glosses their spending as zakat, charity, sacrifice, and feeding people.
rows.anchor: Ve nasip ettiğimiz rızıklarından infak ederler zekât, sadaka verirler, kurban keser

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Budn” refers to the large livestock, especially camels dedicated to the sanctuary.
rows.anchor: Bedeneleri de o bedenlileri, yani en‘âmın iri gövdelilerini ki hareme ihdâ olunan develerdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hadith says a camel and a cow may each be sacrificed for seven people, so cows legally count as budn too.
rows.anchor: mûcebince sığır da deve gibi yedi kişiden kurban edilmek câiz olduğu cihetle şer‘an sığırlar dahi bedene cinsinden ma‘duddur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The offerings are signs that display the manifestations of the religion God prescribed, and bring religious and worldly benefit.
rows.anchor: Allah şe‘âirinden kıldık yani Allah’ın size teşrî‘ettiği dinin tecelliyâtını iş‘âr için alâiminden kıldık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A camel is normally slaughtered standing with one foreleg tied and its throat cut as nahr, though slaughter beneath the jaw is also permitted.
rows.anchor: Deve ayakta iken elinin biri bağlanıp gerdanından boğazlanır ki buna “nahr” tesmiye edilir. Ma‘amâfîh çene altından zebhi de câizdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cattle, sheep, and goats are laid down and slaughtered with three legs tied.
rows.anchor: Sığır ve koyun, keçi ise yatırılıp üç ayağı bağlanarak zebh olunur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At nahr or slaughter, one invokes God’s name, declares His greatness, and says, “O God, from You and to You.”
rows.anchor: Nahr veya zebhte ismullâhın zikri de بسم االله واالله أكبر، اللّهم مِنْكَ إِلَيْكَ denilmektir ki

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the animals’ sides fall, their souls have left their bodies.
rows.anchor: yanları yere düştüğünde ki rûhu çıkmıştır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People may eat only the portions of the offering that are lawful to eat.
rows.anchor: Artık onlardan yiyiniz yani her şeyini değil, yenilmesi câiz olan bazı aksâmından yiyiniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They must also feed both the contented person and the one who comes asking.
rows.anchor: kanaatkâra ve dilenene it‘âm da ediniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God subjected these animals for gratitude, not to satisfy every human desire.
rows.anchor: o teshîr her istediğinizi yapasınız diye değil, şükredesiniz diyedir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Comparing the huge animals with human smallness should reveal material power’s weakness before spiritual force and prompt gratitude for God’s gifts and power.
rows.anchor: insana verdiği nimet ve kudretin kadrini bilmeli de Allah’a şükretmelidir.

rows.speaker: Muhyiddin-i Arabî Hazretleri
rows.claim: Ibn ʿArabī links Mina with attaining a lawful hope or goal, saying that one who reaches a lawful desire has reached the aim.
rows.anchor: Zira meşrû münâya eren gayeye ermiş demektir.

rows.speaker: Muhyiddin-i Arabî Hazretleri
rows.claim: He mystically says animal bodies nourish human bodies; as the bodies are divided their spirits observe, and their bodies are thereafter governed in human form.
rows.anchor: kurbanları nahrda insânî ecsâmın tagaddîsi için hayvânî cisimleri tedbirden rûhlarını itlâf vardır

rows.speaker: Muhyiddin-i Arabî Hazretleri
rows.claim: He calls this a subtle matter understood only by people of God whose insight God has illuminated.
rows.anchor: Bu bir dakīk meseledir ki Allah basiretlerini tenvir etmiş olan ehlullahdan mâ‘adâsı tefattun edemez.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The animals’ meat and blood do not reach God or earn His approval.
rows.anchor: ne etleri ne kanları Allah’a ermez rızâsına nâil olamaz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What reaches God is the worshippers’ taqwa: sincere obedience, reverence, and drawing near to His command.
rows.anchor: kalblerinizi Allah’ın emrine imtisâl ve tâzime ve O’na ihlâs ile tekarruba davet eden takvânızdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the “clear authority” accompanying Moses and Aaron as an “open decree” or manifest command.
rows.anchor: birtakım âyetlerimiz ve açık bir ferman ile Mûsâ’yı ve kardeşi Hârûn’u gönderdik

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the people as too arrogant to accept the prophets and as a stiff-necked people.
rows.anchor: bunlar kibirlerine yediremediler ve dik başlı bir kavim idiler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh’s people reject two humans like themselves, claiming that the prophets’ people serve them.
rows.anchor: Hâlbuki onların kavmi bize kulluk ediyor

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He renders the purpose of giving Moses the Book as enabling those people to follow the right path.
rows.anchor: berikiler doğru yolu tutabilsinler diye Mûsâ’ya o kitabı da verdik

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı says “ghāfilāt” is a commendatory description: believing women are wholly heedless of evil, which never crosses their minds.
rows.anchor: Burada “gāfilât” vasfı medih sıfatlarındandır. Yani ezvâc-ı tâhirât gibi fenalıktan ale’l-ıtlâk gāfil, öyle bir şey asla hatırından geçmez imanlı hanımlara

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He directs the reader to Sūrat Yā Sīn for the testimony of tongues, hands, and feet.
rows.anchor: ki azîm {يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ إلخ} (Sûre-i Yâsîn[^1] bak).

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He interprets “their true dīn” as their just recompense or punishment being fully given.
rows.anchor: O gün Allah, onların hak dinlerini, yani cezâlarını tam verecek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “The Manifest Truth” is God, who makes every truth plain and whose existence admits no doubt.
rows.anchor: yani her hakikati izhar eden ve varlığında hiç şüphe câiz olmayan Hak teâlâ’dır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentant accusers are not expressly excepted here because of the special rights of the Prophet’s purified wives.
rows.anchor: Burada tevbe edenler istisnâ edilmemiştir. Çünkü bunda ezvâc-ı tâhirâtın hukūk-ı mahsûsası itibariyle bir husûsiyet vardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Still, the general implication may allow the repentance exception from the general accusation verse to apply in the hereafter as well.
rows.anchor: Ma‘amâfîh mefhum âmdır. Binâen‘aleyh âm olan kazif âyetindeki istisnânın uhrevî nokta-i nazardan burada da cârî olması melhuzdur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı says Ḥassān ibn Thābit was not a hypocrite but was certainly repentant.
rows.anchor: Hassân b. Sâbit münafık olmamakla beraber tevbekâr olduğunda söz yoktur.

rows.speaker: Hassân b. Sâbit
rows.claim: After the legal punishment, he recited lines vindicating himself and affirming the woman’s chastity and his loyalty to the Prophet’s family.
rows.anchor: Hassân b. Sâbit münafık olmamakla beraber tevbekâr olduğunda söz yoktur. Nitekim hadden sonra inşad ettiği şu beyitlerle tebri’esini arz etmişti

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Âişe
rows.claim: Al-Rāzī reports that ʿĀʾisha hoped Ḥassān would enter Paradise after hearing his poetry praising the Messenger.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Âişe radıyallahu anhâ da “Hassân’a cenneti ümid ederim, Resûlullah’ın medhine dair şiirini işittiğim zaman ona cenneti ümid ettim” demiştir. (Râzî)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı connects the sky’s splitting with the rising of the “cloud” mentioned in al-Baqara 2:210.
rows.anchor: kavl-i celîlinde zikrolunan “gamâm”ın tulû‘u sebebiyle semânın şakkolacağı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only the Merciful’s sovereignty remains because every other dominion will pass away.
rows.anchor: Çünkü o gün her mülk zeval bulur. Ancak Rahmân’ın hakkı olan mülk kalır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He repeats the verse’s description of the Day as harsh for disbelievers.
rows.anchor: ve kâfirlere pek zorluklu bir gün olmuştur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Biting one’s hands is a metaphor for regret mixed with anger and grief.
rows.anchor: Mâlum ki “el ısırmak” hiddet ve hasretle nedâmetten kinayedir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “The wrongdoer” refers to the class generally, not only one individual.
rows.anchor: “zâlim”den murad cinstir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The occasion of revelation is said to have been ʿUqbah ibn Abī Muʿayṭ.
rows.anchor: sebeb-i nüzûl Ukbe b. Ebî
